- Assumed a 90-second match, with a 10-frag win condition and bots as opponents.

## Objective
- Complete and verify a playable, mobile-first browser 3D arena shooter with fast movement, multiple weapons, vertical combat, and touch controls.

## Requirements
- Implement mobile-friendly movement, bunny-hop/strafe momentum, jumping and sliding; plasma, railgun, and rocket weapons; and a vertical arena.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Built the game with Three.js and Vite, including a custom neon sci-fi arena and HUD.
- Assumed a 90-second match, 10-frag win condition, and bots as opponents.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented arena geometry, HUD/start/end screens, desktop and mobile controls, movement physics, three weapons, bots, projectiles, damage, frags, and match timer.
- `npm install` completed and `npm run build` passes.
- Previously opened the game in Playwright and captured `screenshots/arena.png`; the start screen rendered.

### Active
- Investigate and fix browser errors: `THREE.BufferGeometry.computeBoundingSphere(): Computed radius is NaN. The "position" attribute is likely to have NaN values. BoxGeometry`.
- Enter a match in Playwright, check runtime errors and gameplay controls, and capture a gameplay screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue tracking the NaN-producing geometry; inspection of `game.js` found only constant, positive dimensions in the `BoxGeometry` calls checked so far.
2. Use Playwright to enter a match and inspect console errors and gameplay/mobile controls.
3. Rebuild, review repository status, and summarize the result and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, arena construction, game state, controls, combat, and update loop.
- `index.html`: HUD and game screens.
- `style.css`: responsive styling and mobile controls.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and dependency.

## Important Context
- The previous browser check showed two BoxGeometry NaN errors and a missing `/favicon.ico` 404; the cause remains unresolved.
- `npm run build` passes.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files, `dist/`, and support files as untracked.

## Objective
- Complete and verify a playable, mobile-first browser 3D arena shooter with fast movement, multiple weapons, vertical combat, and touch controls.

## Requirements
- Support mobile-friendly movement, bunny-hop/strafe momentum, jumping and sliding; plasma, railgun, and rocket weapons; and a vertical arena.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Built with Three.js and Vite, using a custom neon sci-fi arena and bots as opponents.
- Assumed a 90-second match and a 10-frag win condition.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented arena, HUD and screens, desktop/mobile controls, movement physics, three weapons, bots, projectiles, damage, frags, and match timer.
- Fixed the two `BoxGeometry` NaN errors by adding the missing `48` depth to the side `wall rail` geometry; added `favicon.svg` to prevent the favicon 404.
- Aligned timeout victory with the 10-frag win condition.
- `npm run build` passes; desktop and mobile Playwright checks show no browser errors.
- Verified desktop weapon selection and movement; confirmed mobile controls display and tested weapon/jump buttons.
- Captured `screenshots/gameplay.png` and `screenshots/mobile-gameplay.png`.

### Active
- Finish gameplay quality checks, especially mobile joystick/aim/fire interactions and whether bot damage makes matches too short.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test mobile joystick, aiming, and held fire in an active match.
2. Review bot difficulty: the desktop gameplay capture ended in defeat at `00:07` with 0 frags; adjust only if gameplay confirms this is too punishing.
3. Rebuild and capture a gameplay screenshot that shows an active match.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: arena, controls, movement, combat, bot behavior, and match flow.
- `index.html`: HUD, screens, mobile controls, and favicon reference.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and touch-control styling.
- `screenshots/gameplay.png`: desktop capture; shows defeat at 00:07.
- `screenshots/mobile-gameplay.png`: mobile capture with controls visible.
- `package.json`: build and development commands.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files, `dist/`, and support files appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Earlier NaN errors identified two malformed side wall-rail `BoxGeometry` calls; the missing depth argument is fixed.
- Mobile browser checks reported four rendering-related warnings, but no JavaScript errors.

- Complete and verify a playable, mobile-first browser 3D arena shooter with fast movement, multiple weapons, vertical combat, and touch controls.
